objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed paperless document in DHC VISION, including creation, editing, release, distribution, archiving, versioning and validity handling.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Corresponding document type selected when creating a new document.

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Abbreviation for the document; type abbreviations are listed for common document types and are not language-independent.

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: Assigned consecutive number of the document.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Document property maintained to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: Document property maintained to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Document property maintained to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Document property maintained to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed automatically in the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed automatically in the document and used in workflows/life cycle.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed automatically in the document.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign reader authorizations via a user group assignment.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Attribute for assigning the author; the creator is automatically confirmed in this field by default.

attributes.name: co_authors
attributes.description: Attribute for assigning additional personal change rights.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Attribute for assigning reviewers.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Attribute for assigning releasers, including translation.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which document validity starts, calculated from release of a document.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period for which a check of extended validity is necessary; can be defined for each document type.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Validity expiry date calculated from valid from date and period of extended validity.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Archive duration definable for each document type.

attributes.name: distribution_by_info
attributes.description: Attribute whose later change affects existing user groups and persons regarding email notification when the next version is released.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: Attribute whose later change affects existing user groups and persons regarding workflow task distribution when the next version is released.

objs.name: policy
objs.description: Document type used for company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level.

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: Document type describing locally defined regulations or regulations relating to a business process.

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: Document type describing specific procedures, process sequence, details and responsible persons within a framework.

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: Document type documenting special work steps and detailed steps usually relevant for a few departments.

objs.name: form
objs.description: Additional form that can supplement work instructions.

objs.name: checklist
objs.description: Checklist that can supplement work instructions.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template that can be defined for each document type and selected when creating new objects.

objs.name: object_cover
objs.description: Pure object cover to which external files or documents can be uploaded or new documents generated.

objs.name: external_file
objs.description: External file that can be uploaded to an object cover.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Object type that supplements a document with additional information and is released and published directly via switches in properties.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document attached to a main document, automatically released with the release of the main document and subject to its own versioning.

objs.name: equippment
objs.description: Document attachment mentioned as relevant equipment/additional supplement to documents.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group of users used for system roles, reader assignments, distribution, archive access and authorizations.

objs.name: person
objs.description: Individual user/person assigned personal authorizations or distribution.

objs.name: role
objs.description: Implemented system role/license role providing users with functions according to area of application.

objs.name: authorization_group
objs.description: Defined group in the system assigned to documents to grant read and change rights to users/persons.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal for changes to documents, clearly belonging to a document and managed in its folder.

attributes.name: note
attributes.description: Note about an existing Change proposal that can be printed in a new document version.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: Request created by the system before document validity expires and linked to the document to be checked.

objs.name: request_for_aks
objs.description: Request for AKS created to invalidate a selected document.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created in the provided folder to reactivate an invalidated document.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List per document containing user groups and persons for distribution by e-mail or acknowledgement.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation of acknowledgement requested from persons and users of assigned user groups.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status used in reports listing acknowledgements.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: User and role-specific dashboard filled using distribution groups in a document distribution list.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Role-specific evaluation report available for documents in the system.

attributes.name: selection_parameters
attributes.description: Parameters available for reports that influence evaluation results.

attributes.name: selection_criteria
attributes.description: Criteria available for reports that filter result lists.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system in which document visibility can be specified.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: Language-dependent translated version of a released document.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Master data to which documents can be linked, e.g. IT applications.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Process with which documents can be linked.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Organizational unit with which documents can be linked.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Risk with which documents can be linked.
